# Potential Unexplored Ltd (PUL)

> Potential Unexplored Ltd is a Ugandan-founded organisational strengthening and life readiness consultancy serving institutions, young people and adults across Uganda and Africa. It was founded by Banio Luiji Nobert, a leadership coach, conference speaker, author of twelve books, and GALS and ERI Approach Master Trainer. PUL and its team have facilitated more than 130 training, coaching and mentorship sessions over the last five years for institutions across Uganda and Africa, including UNHCR, Bank of Uganda, Centenary Bank, the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program, horizont3000, War Child Canada, Opportunity International, Gulu University and Uganda Christian University.

## Organisational Development (for institutions)
- [Leadership Development](https://potentialunexplored.com/leadership-development.html): leadership and management development for managers, founders and executives, starting with self-leadership, then people leadership
- [Team Building Events](https://potentialunexplored.com/team-building.html): participatory team building for institutions of any size, designed to surface and address the real state of the team
- [Sales and Customer Service Excellence](https://potentialunexplored.com/sales-excellence.html): training built on understanding people first and techniques second
- [Team building and leadership for NGOs in Uganda](https://potentialunexplored.com/team-building-and-leadership-training-for-ngos-in-uganda.html): retreats, consortium team building and leadership programmes for NGOs and UN agencies
- [Organisational Strengthening overview](https://potentialunexplored.com/organisational-strengthening.html)

## Life Readiness Programme (for young people and adults)
- [Boys to Men Mentorship Camp](https://boystomencamp.com/): residential mentorship camp for boys and young men aged 8 to 23
- [Girls Life Readiness Camp](https://potentialunexplored.com/girls-rising.html): life readiness programme for girls
- [MEP Masterclass](https://potentialunexplored.com/mep-masterclass.html): live online programme for adults on Mindset, Entrepreneurship and Personal Growth
- [School Support](https://potentialunexplored.com/school-support.html): holistic support for schools
- [Life Readiness overview](https://potentialunexplored.com/life-readiness-programme.html)
